body:
Founder real-time: 'ensure the shankpit rigid body stuff landed' -- it hadn't. SHANKPIT@6204ea9 merges the formal rigid-body physics work (packages/goldenband grb/grobot/grl vendored from GOLDENBAND, packages/simulation/rigid_ragdoll -- mannequin as 17 rigid capsules with Winter/Dempster masses and swing/twist-limited joints) from origin/claude/determined-mccarthy-f5ou9d into master. That branch was pushed to origin earlier the same day (session sess-20260927-1025-5b0d7c3e) but never opened as a PR -- same abandoned-branch pattern already fixed for IDUNA in BACKLOG.md SECTION 558. Verified live, not assumed: 'make test-physics' passes (falls, settles, holds every swing/twist/hinge limit, bit-identical on rerun), 'make lobby'/'make server' both still build clean. Only merge conflict was CHANGELOG.md (both entries kept). Not wired into live gameplay yet -- explicitly scoped that way by the original commit.

⚓ ☃
title: Rigid-body physics branch landed on master (was abandoned, no PR)
